summary: To listen, attend and heed. Listening is not the same as hearing, 聞.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Burke–Shaw trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 遠 takes the point farthest from the system’s centre, 孤 the most isolated of the rest, and 寂 the point nearest the centre. A design choice, not a claim.

satellites.title: What Does Heaven Say?
satellites.evidence: Analects 17.19: 予欲無言 … 天何言哉？四時行焉，百物生焉，天何言哉 — “I wish to say nothing … What does Heaven say? The four seasons go round, the hundred things are born. What does Heaven say?” A sky that does not speak, and is not empty.

satellites.title: Listening with the Breath
satellites.evidence: Zhuangzi 4, the fasting of the heart: 無聽之以耳而聽之以心，無聽之以心而聽之以氣 — “listen not with the ear but with the heart; not with the heart but with the breath.”
